newsitem.title: UK: LME aluminium near day's high, zinc dips in PM.
newsitem.headline: LME aluminium near day's high, zinc dips in PM.

text.p: ALUMINIUM - Near 19-month high of $1,716 a tonne on investment fund buying but finding resistance. Needs to breach $1,725 for further gain.
ZINC - Falls from a high of $1,535 to $1,510 under profit-taking. Nearbys tight, cash/threes at $110/$120 backwardation.
COPPER - Down slightly, quiet TIN/NICKEL - Consolidating gains.
